definition: CPU/GPU/NPU/ISP/VPU/I/O integrated in SoC or module
typical_examples: RK3588; Qualcomm IQ-9075; Atlas 200I A2; BM1688
main_strengths: short data path; shared memory; compact integration; camera/video integration
main_constraints: vendor SDK dependency; shared DDR contention; exact camera/security capability varies by SKU

definition: GPU-centric module or robot computer with general parallel compute
main_constraints: power; thermal; weight; cost; localization requirements

main_strengths: high DNN efficiency; modular expansion; optional large local memory
main_constraints: host still handles camera/VIO/planning; PCIe copies; system power not equal card power

definition: complete edge box combining host SoC/CPU and one or more accelerators
main_strengths: productized modular architecture; host handles media/OS while accelerator scales AI
main_constraints: E2E latency depends on host/PCIe/pre-post; larger board/thermal design

definition: independent FCU/MCU handles hard realtime; Linux AI computer handles autonomy
main_strengths: isolation between hard realtime control and AI/Linux workload; graceful degradation
main_constraints: dual-domain integration; interface/security design; more system components

definition: industrial enclosure computer with power, CAN, GMSL/Ethernet and environmental design
main_constraints: weight/volume often unsuitable for small UAV

definition: near-edge or server compute supporting local devices
main_strengths: large compute/memory; fleet/global optimization; model services
main_constraints: network dependency; cannot replace local safety loop
